prompt: The same woman from the reference image, in the same plain studio with the same clothes and lighting, demonstrates a Tai Chi movement for beginners aged 50+. She begins and ends in exactly the neutral standing posture of the reference image (feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at the sides) so the clip loops seamlessly. Static locked camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, full body always in frame from head to feet, feet visible on the floor, background unchanged.
